spec.studio_prompt: A modern tall floor planter measuring 40 cm in diameter and 80 cm in height, holding a flourishing agave succulent spanning 70 cm in width. The planter features a seamless, elongated bullet-tapered cylindrical body made of smooth matte charcoal black composite (#262624). Inside the rim, a fine natural gravel dressing supports a dense, upward-radiating rosette of thick, sharp lanceolate agave leaves in a muted dusty sage green (#515a4d) and chalky grey-green (#a3aaaa) finish with realistic waxy succulent surface texture.
